questions.question:
This question consists of a pair of words which have a certain relationship to each other. Select the pair which does NOT have the same relationship.

Smart : Intelligent

1) Liable : Accountable

2) Modest : Humble

3) Nimble : Sluggish

4) Outbreak : Eruption
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Identifying Synonyms**.

Here,

Smart : Intelligent → **Smart** and **Intelligent** are synonyms.

Similarly,

Liable : Accountable → **Liable** and **Accountable** are synonyms.

Modest : Humble → **Modest** and **Humble** are synonyms.

Outbreak : Eruption → **Outbreak** and **Eruption** are synonyms.

However,

Nimble : Sluggish → **Nimble** and **Sluggish** are antonyms, not synonyms.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 22 March 2000 is a Wednesday, then what will the day of the week on 16th January 2010?
questions.solution: Given: **22 March 2000** was Wednesday. Now, 2000 to 2009 = 9 Years (7 Ordinary Years and 2 Leap Years). And, In 9 Years = 2 Leap years and 7 Ordinary Years. So, 2 Leap Years have 4 odd days, And, 7 Ordinary Years have 7 odd days. Total odd days = 4 + 7 = 11.

questions.question:
If ‘A’ stands for '÷', 'B' stands for '×', 'C' stands for ‘+' and 'D' stands for ‘-', what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation? 

222 A 2 C 7 B 3 D 11 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 222 A 2 C 7 B 3 D 11 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 ÷
 ×
 +
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ __**222 ÷ 2**__ + 7 × 3 - 11 = ?

⇒ __**111 + 7**__ × 3 - 11 = ?

⇒ __**111 + 21**__ - 11 = ?

⇒ __**132 - 11**__ = ?

⇒ **121**

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 19 February 2014 was Wednesday, then what was the day of the week on 19 February 2022?
questions.solution:
Given: **19 February 2014** was Wednesday.

Now,

2014 to 2022 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Year and 2 Leap Year).

And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap years and 6 Ordinary Year.

So, 2 Leap Year has 4 odd days,

And, 6 Ordinary Year has 6 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10.

10 odd days → 10/7 = 1 week and 3 odd days.

then, 19 February 2022 will be Wednesday + 3 = Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No cloud is a mountain.

All mountains are rivers.

All rivers are oceans.

**Conclusions:**

(I) All rivers can never be clouds.

(II) All mountains are oceans.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Given statements:

No cloud is a mountain.

All mountains are rivers.

All rivers are oceans.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/542d094d2cbbd08be5d510cb1d7ca5865c230aedbab35631b3556119e46c2ef9.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All rivers can never be clouds. - True (Because there is no direct relation between rivers and clouds so it can be possible)

(II) All mountains are oceans. - True (Because All mountains are rivers and All rivers are oceans, so all mountains are oceans it is definite)

So, Both conclusions I and II follow

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation if ‘+’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘–’ are interchanged?

36 – 42 ÷ 26 + 13 × 14 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95c213b377d7cb2f72e5aed4678e5527fce29253034e495ae617ace309ff2cfc.png] 

Given equation: 36 – 42 ÷ 26 + 13 × 14 = ?

If ‘+’ and ‘÷’ and ‘×’ and ‘–’ are interchanged then we get:

⇒ 36 × 42 + __**26 ÷ 13**__ - 14 = ?

⇒ __**36 × 42**__ + 2 - 14 = ?

⇒ **__1512__**__** **____**+ 2**__ - 14 = ?

⇒ __1514__ __**- 14 **__= ? = **1500**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’,

 Symbol
 @
 #
 &
 $
 
 

 Meaning
 Husband 
 Mother 
 Daughter 
 Brother 
 
 

 

Given: M & N @ O # P $ Q

It means: M is the daughter of N, N is the husband of O, O is the mother of P and P is the brother of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
